description: Pauses or resumes delivery for one list. Resuming can use a source slot and is refused if another active list covers the same form and connection.

account_id.description: Admin keys only: the LeadSync account (user id, integer or digit string) to act on; overrides LEADSYNC_ACCOUNT

active.description: true to resume delivery, false to pause it

list_id.description: LeadSync list id from list_leads or attach_form

override_limits.description: Admin keys with write access only: skip account and plan limits

name: set_list_active
